name: Moneyboxx Finance Ltd
title: Moneyboxx Finance Ltd - 538446 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Small-ticket MSME NBFC in stress: GNPA fell to 3.59% from 6.61% and credit cost guided below 2%, but AUM grew only 6% on an ARC sale and FY26 PAT was just INR1.34 crore.

triggers.label: Credit cost guided below 2% FY27
triggers.quote: This year, we seriously expect that this number should go down below 2%.

triggers.label: AUM growth guided 43-44% for FY27
triggers.quote: we have projected about 43% to 44% AUM jump for this year.

triggers.label: Disbursements down; some decline in demand
triggers.quote: yes, some decline in demand has happened.

triggers.label: Opex ratio 12.8%, high on small AUM
triggers.quote: as AUM grows, the cost will keep coming down.

guidance.quote: This year, we seriously expect that this number should go down below 2%.
we have projected about 43% to 44% AUM jump for this year.
targeting nearly 80% secured AUM by March 2027, including loans backed by guarantee program.

guidance.metric: Renewable energy loans share of AUM
guidance.quote: maybe around 10% of the AUM by March '27

red_flags.label: Equity raise needed; FY27 plan relies on H2 equity
red_flags.quote: we will target to raise some equity in the second half of the year.

red_flags.label: Gross NPA rising quarter-on-quarter; old stressed portfolio
red_flags.quote: there is an old portfolio which got into some stress, which will be handled through legal actions

red_flags.label: Management says AUM growth 43-44% promised to lenders
red_flags.quote: we have projected about 43% to 44% AUM jump for this year.

evasions.quote: The disbursements will be better than last year, definitely.
So sectors, as I said, things have not been great earlier
